hypothesis: A causally confirmed pivot sequence approximating impulse waves 1-2 or 1-2-3-4, followed by breakout of the preceding wave high or low, may improve monthly consistency over the same-instrument buy-and-hold control.
parameter_rationale: Three short-to-medium pivot confirmation wings (2,3,5 bars), three reversal thresholds (2%,4%,6%), and two causal setup stages (wave-3 breakout after waves 1-2; wave-5 breakout after waves 1-4) form the complete preregistered 2x3x3 grid. No per-stock tuning. Elliott labels are only an OHLC proxy, not a verified discretionary count.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same instrument and timeframe, next-open execution, identical costs
signal_rule: A pivot at p is unavailable until close of p+wing. Significant alternating pivots require deviation_pct; a more extreme same-side pivot replaces only future setup state. Long wave3 proxy requires confirmed L0-H1-L2 with L2>L0 and L2<H1; buy only on the later close crossing H1. Short is mirrored. Long wave5 proxy requires confirmed L0-H1-L2-H3-L4 with L2>L0, H3>H1, L4>H1 and L4<H3; buy only on later close crossing H3. Short is mirrored. These are necessary geometric checks, not a complete Elliott taxonomy; no retroactive trades. A close through latest confirmed opposite pivot produces an exit. Order fills next bar open with 15 bps per side; 25% of account equity. Same bar pivot confirmations are incorporated only after evaluating that bar's trade signal.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Research comparison only; no automatic paper promotion. Compare matched annual and monthly PnL against buy-and-hold, breadth across stocks, and neighboring parameter settings.
limitations: Wave counts have multiple valid interpretations; this experiment tests one narrow causal proxy, not the entire Elliott Wave Principle
Confirmed pivots lag by wing bars and are never traded at their historical pivot timestamp
Wave 3 cannot be proven non-shortest before wave 5 ends; the setup deliberately avoids claiming that rule is satisfied at entry
Unequal stock histories and missing candle periods must be shown in validation
Corporate actions, borrow cost and lots are not fully modeled; no real-trading inference
